The consigned PCB HR-30110 has one open line, HPO-26-00629/10 (830 EA, about $12.6K, owner Marcus Chen): promised 25 Sep 2026, and Lanxin's allocation notice of 16 Sep moves it to 16 Oct, 21 days later. It is not yet past due, and it is not counted as arriving until 16 Oct. No shortage is raised for HR-30110 because the notice is a later date rather than a stop, so the 830 boards arrive 16 Oct unless there is stock. The same notice moves Lanxin's HPO-26-00629/20 (HR-30120, 950 EA) to 19 Oct, but HR-30120 is not in any robot's bill of materials, so it has no build impact.

args.subject: HPO-26-00629 line 10, PCB HR-30110: earlier date or partial shipment
args.body:
Dear Huang Shu-fen,

Your notice of 16 September moves PCB, safety controller rev B (HR-30110), on HPO-26-00629 line 10 (830 EA) from 25 September to 16 October. This board is consigned to our assembler and goes into every robot, so the later date matters to us.

Could you please:
- tell us whether an earlier date, or a partial shipment ahead of 16 October, is possible on HPO-26-00629 line 10;
- confirm the revised promise date for HPO-26-00629 line 10 in writing.

Please reply as soon as you can.

Best regards,
Marcus Chen
